prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render a finished desktop website screen edge to edge, without browser chrome, for Martino Ferrero's personal portfolio. Recruiters and potential clients need to understand his backend and AI engineering work, discover his projects, and reach him. Use these exact English words: 'Martino Ferrero', 'Software Engineer · AI & Backend', 'About', 'Projects', 'Skills', 'Contact', 'Neurollow', and 'Lookeate'. Show a compact transparent fixed navigation, a centered introduction and the beginning of the about or projects content below. Base its familiar polished portfolio structure on contemporary developer portfolios with a calm centered column, a small portrait within the about content, and a straightforward vertical sequence of project names with short neutral descriptions and simple text links. Nearly black is the dominant background, with predominantly white normal sans-serif text and only the faintest dark blue-violet shading. Simple thin rules and a few tiny points may suggest connections, without any large network. Emphasize a professional, quiet and continuous experience; any animation will be understated scroll reveal in implementation. No large portrait, decorative diagrams around the face, bright gradients, card grid, project artwork, fancy icons or modal. The supplied caricature is only a reference for the small portrait.
